route.reason: Contraindications are a section of the FDA drug label for Ozempic (semaglutide), so the label is the appropriate source.

draft.text: Ozempic (semaglutide) is contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or in patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2) [label:semaglutide:contraindications:0]. It is also contraindicated in patients with a serious hypersensitivity reaction to semaglutide or to any of the excipients in Ozempic, and serious hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis and angioedema have been reported [label:semaglutide:contraindications:0]. The warnings section likewise advises not to use Ozempic in patients with a previous hypersensitivity to it [label:semaglutide:warnings_and_cautions:11].
